title: Welcoming Stories that Cross Borders
subtitle: Immigrants and Refugees
welcome: Immigrants and Refugees in the Light of International Law
description: This project is born from listening, respect and empathy. Our goal is to understand the trajectories of those who left their country in search of safety and a new beginning, analyzing their rights and challenges in Brazil. Here, we seek to inform, raise awareness and strengthen humanitarian reception in our community.
